messages:
Maya: Heads-up — postmortem follow-ups for last night's KV OOM are in the doc but we need a tighter owner/timeline model. I opened this thread to collect quick commitments.
Chris: +1. Main pattern: residency climb on warm hosts after long tail of small requests. We saw repeated fragmentation spikes.
Oliver: I pulled flamegraphs and heap maps, looks like a steady growth in shard-residency for certain model sizes (seq_len 2048). Sharing link: https://redwood-internal/eng/issues/kw-4321
Sara: Can someone list the proposed mitigations and owners? I can add them to the action tracker and ensure weekly reminders.
Maya: Proposed list (short):
- short-term: evasive limits + immediate canary soft-limit (owner: Chris, ETA 48h)
- profiling: perf capture + heap snapshots on 5 repro hosts (owner: Oliver, ETA 72h)
- GC/allocator tweak: try aggressive slab reclaim flag on a staged canary (owner: Jamie, ETA 1 week)
- long-term: eviction heuristics + residency regression alert (owner: Maya, ETA 3 weeks)
Chris: For the soft-limit, I'll push a canary config:
```json
{"kv.residency_soft_limit": 0.75, "eviction.batch_ms": 20}
```
I'll put a deploy in dev and one small region first.
Jamie: On GC tweaks — discovered `slab_reclaim_threshold=0.6` reduced fragmentation in local testing but increased latency p99 on tiny workloads. Need to quantify. I'll run A/B for two days.
Oliver: For profiling, suggest we capture both jemalloc stats + runtime residency trace. I'll add a script to the ops repo: `scripts/kv_profile_collect.sh` (will attach).
Sara: I'll own the tracker PR and add recurring follow-up every Mon at 10am for 4 weeks. Also will map remediation items to the postmortem tickets and prod SLO impact.
Chris: Quick risk note — soft-limit may induce short-lived increased evictions; we'll set fallback to fallback-model-route for 5m.
Maya: PostmortemBot: linked postmortem: PM-2026-KV-RESIDENCY. Please reference in each action.
PostmortemBot: auto-note: PM-2026-KV-RESIDENCY linked to thread 4145678910.
Jamie: TL;DR action commitments: Chris(soft-limit canary, 48h), Oliver(profiling run, 72h), Jamie(GC A/B, 1w), Maya(eviction alerts + rollout plan, 3w), Sara(tracker + weekly check-ins).
Maya: If anyone can't meet ETA, drop a quick note here so we can reassign. I want explicit sign-offs by EOD tomorrow.
Oliver: Signed — starting profiling now, will post artifacts in tracker.
Chris: Signed — canary config PR up in 30m.
Sara: Signed — PR for tracker scheduled in 1h, will add Monday cadence.
Jamie: Signed — will start A/B tomorrow morning.
Maya: Thanks — I'll compile into the action roster and ping infra-schedule for calendar blocks. :thumbsup:
Sara: Also adding a short smoke test checklist for canary: 1) baseline mem before, 2) sim traffic for 6h, 3) validate p95/p99 latency and evictions count.
Maya: Great. We'll regroup in next Mon async update and escalate earlier if regressions or new OOMs appear.
Chris: FYI, I'll add a quick metric dashboard tile for 'residency trend by shard' to make the regression alert actionable.
Maya: Closing note: keep logs and heap dumps retained for 14 days in the artifacts bucket so anyone can inspect.
Sara: Copy that. I'll add retention policy to the tracker entry.
Maya: End of thread summary posted to the postmortem doc and tracker. Thanks everyone.
